title: invariants.v1
description: The behavioural invariants of one diagram: rules that must always hold across the flow (ordering, never-before, timeout, retry, non-blocking) and that the diagram tool cannot express. One YAML file next to the diagram, <diagram>.invariants.yaml, reviewed with it at checkpoint 1. The adapter merges each entry into the diagram's element list as kind invariant. That every element named in constrains exists in the diagram is a check_diagram_contract_gate rule.

diagram.description: The diagram these invariants belong to (same ID as in diagram.v1).

statement.description: The rule, one sentence, on one line.

constrains.description: IDs of the diagram elements the rule spans (e.g. the messages whose order it fixes).
